process_issues.description: Every Bash call failed before running, including `gh pr view 237 ...`, `git diff b98e363e570950d767f01e0eda328c372b256f3e..HEAD --stat` and a bare `git rev-parse HEAD`. Each one exited 1 with `apply-seccomp: write /proc/self/setgroups (nested userns is capability-restricted; caller must provide CAP_SYS_ADMIN): Permission denied`. The sandbox could not start on this runner, so the PR diff, file list, PR body and threads, and head SHA could not be read.

No reviewers were spawned. Reviewer subagents use the same Bash sandbox to read the change (`gh pr diff`, `git diff <merge_base>..HEAD`), so any review would have been guesswork about code it couldn't see. The second freshness check couldn't run either. PR #237 (2 commits after the merge base b98e363: e113475 and 2d43fdb, on killing gate child process groups during the stop grace) was NOT reviewed. This record is not a clean review. Re-run once the runner allows the sandbox's nested user namespace (CAP_SYS_ADMIN / unprivileged userns), or with the Bash sandbox configured to work on this runner.
